modules.title: Validated observation and timing contracts
modules.boundary: Acquisition truth is not established by metadata or signatures.

modules.title: Per-channel integrity and usable-input assessment
modules.boundary: Engineering integrity checks are not neurological diagnoses.

modules.title: Qualified decoding and temporal intent evidence
modules.boundary: A supported class is a hypothesis, not proof of true intent.

modules.title: Accessible interaction and assistance negotiation
modules.boundary: No universal interface or preferred assistance level is assumed.

modules.title: Independent action admission and execution protocol
modules.boundary: Atomic dispatch assumptions and in-flight effects must be explicit.

modules.title: Bounded task planning and plant-specific recovery
modules.boundary: Simulation constraint satisfaction is not physical safety certification.

modules.title: Qualified adaptation and user-model interaction
modules.boundary: No promotion from self-generated semantic labels alone.

modules.title: Privacy, authorship and isolated proposal workers
modules.boundary: Integrity, privacy and intended meaning are separate properties.

modules.title: Replay capsules and lifecycle recovery
modules.boundary: Private data omitted from a run cannot later be reconstructed for exact replay.

modules.title: Independent evaluation and failure analysis
modules.boundary: Offline, simulated, hardware, human and deployment evidence remain distinct.
